spec.assertion: Ally-scoped damage-REDUCTION has no payload (v1 boss deals no damage to the team). Asserts NO boss-held damageTakenPct buffApply (casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null) is emitted — fails under the nearest-wrong model that reads ▼2% on allies as the enemy-scoped damageTakenPct debuff (where positive = boss takes MORE), which would either fabricate or subtract real team damage. The stack itself is retained because it gates the ammo line.

Non-vacuity guard: asserts mica fires ≥1200 rounds in 180s, i.e. the fixture genuinely reaches 10×120 landed normal attacks. Without this every downstream ammo assertion could pass vacuously against a model that grants nothing. 15 sec is the per-stack decay window; mica's SMG cadence keeps it refreshed, so the cap is reachable.

Weapon-state IS damage: asserts team total with the maxAmmoPct effect > team total with it stripped. Fails under the 'ammo capacity is defensive, skip it' model (failure-mode #6) — a bigger magazine means fewer reload gaps and strictly more rounds fired by every ally.

Asserts the maxAmmoPct buffApply reaches >1 distinct targetSlug including a non-mica unit, and value === 40. Fails under an allies→self mis-scope (failure-mode #4) and under a maxAmmoFlat mis-encoding of a percentage line.

spec.kitLine: when Tidying Up is at max stacks
spec.assertion: Trigger identity: asserts team total under the stack-gated model is STRICTLY LESS than under a patched passive-from-t=0 model, and that the first ammo buffApply lands after frame 600 (>10s). Fails under the over-eager reading that grants the whole team +40% magazine for the entire fight (failure-mode #3).

Duration semantics: asserts every ammo buffApply carries no durationShots and either no expiresFrame or one beyond fight length. Fails under a model that copies the neighbouring '15 sec' onto the ammo line (failure-mode #2).

it.skip — no primitive. The EffectDef vocabulary has no effect that increments another buff's LIVE stack count; `maxStacks` is a self-declared CAP, not a third-party-mutable counter, and there is no stackCount stat. Encoding it as +1 maxStacks would be wrong on both axes (cap vs current count; cross-unit ally scope). Belongs in unmodeled.skill2.

Asserts a burstGenPct buffApply with value 300, targetSlug === mica only, first applied at frame 0; and that stripping it yields strictly FEWER fullBurstStart events. Fails under an allies-scoped mis-read, a later trigger, and under the 'gauge is not damage, skip it' model — mica is a Burst I so her ×4 fill rate is rotation-load-bearing.

Caster-scaled: asserts casterAtkPct buffApply events exist, that their emitted value is NOT 39.93 (it flat-resolves to 0.3993×mica.staticAtk per the harness contract), that the flat value is IDENTICAL across all recipients (a caster-scaled constant), and that no plain atkPct 39.93 apply exists. Fails under the nearest-wrong atkPct model, which scales each target's OWN ATK — a different number per ally and a different mechanic.

Asserts every ally slug in the comp appears as a casterAtkPct target, that team total exceeds the self-scoped counterfactual, and that specifically the ALLY rows moved between the two runs (inertness direction check — proving the delta came from the ally grant, not an incidental rotation shift). Fails under the allies→self mis-scope.

Duration semantics: asserts durationShots is absent (no 'round(s)' wording → not a round-count line) and expiresFrame - frame is 280..320 (≈300 frames @60fps). Fails under a permanent-buff reading and under a durationShots mis-encoding (failure-mode #2).

Asserts the count of distinct casterAtkPct apply frames equals mica's own burstCast count. Fails under a fullBurstEnter re-key, which fires on ANY team Full Burst and over-credits whenever another unit completes the chain (failure-mode #3).
it.skip — the sim models no ally-side debuffs (the boss deals no damage and applies nothing to the team), so cleansing has no observable payload. Belongs in unmodeled.burst.

fixtures: controlComp('mica-snow-buddy', true) for all 5 runs — the standard control comp with the fixed B3 slot ON. Mica is a Burst I, so a comp WITHOUT B2/B3 partners would cast zero Full Bursts and every rotation/gauge assertion would be vacuous; the fixed B3 supplies the stage-3 caster that closes the chain. The fixed B3's own buffs do not confound any assertion here because every discriminating claim is either (a) read off mica's OWN buffApply events filtered by stat, or (b) an A/B delta against a withPatchedOverride counterfactual of mica's override only — the rest of the comp is identical on both sides. Deterministic, no seed. Five hoisted runComp calls: BASE, NO_AMMO (maxAmmo effects stripped), AMMO_FROM_ZERO (ammo block re-triggered as passive), NO_GAUGE (burstGenPct stripped), BURST_SELF (burst ATK re-targeted to self).
gaps: skill2 'Stack count of buffs ▲ 1' — no stack-count-manipulation primitive in EffectDef; maxStacks is a self-declared CAP, not a live counter a third party can increment, and there is no stackCount/stackBonus StatKey. Modeling it as +1 maxStacks would misrepresent both the quantity (cap vs current) and the scope (it affects all allies' buffs). it.skip'd; belongs in unmodeled.skill2.

skill1 'Tidying Up: Damage Taken ▼ 2%' payload — the v1 boss deals no damage to the team, so an ally-side damage-reduction stack has no observable payload. Only the DEFENSIVE VALUE is unmodeled; the stack COUNT is load-bearing (it gates the +40% Max Ammunition line) so the block must still exist to carry the counter. Explicitly must NOT be encoded as the boss-held damageTakenPct debuff.
burst 'Removes 1 debuff(s)' — no ally-side debuff channel exists in the sim; nothing observable to assert. it.skip'd; belongs in unmodeled.burst.
